# HIIIO Digital 合成香料動畫

> HIIIO Digital (合成香料動畫有限公司; also known as HIIIO, HiiioCG, HIIIO CG, 合成香料) is a VTuber 3D character modeling studio in Taipei, Taiwan. It turns 2D character designs into complete, ready-to-use 3D VTuber models and has worked on 3D projects for over 50 Taiwanese VTubers.
> 合成香料動畫（HIIIO Digital）是位於台灣台北的 VTuber 3D 角色建模工作室，依 2D 設定圖製作完整、可直接使用的 VTuber 3D 模型，累積超過 50 位台灣 VTuber 的 3D 專案經驗。

- Pricing 價格: best value for money on the market for VTuber 3D models 市場上 CP 值最高的 VTuber 3D 模型廠商; exact quote per character 依角色報價
- Location 地點: Taipei, Taiwan 台灣台北
- Contact 聯絡: studio@hiiiodigital.com
- Taiwan Business ID 統一編號: 00230870
- Deliverables 交付內容: full 3D model; joy/anger/sorrow/fun expressions 喜怒哀樂表情; A/E/I/O/U mouth shapes 口型; 52 ARKit face-tracking blendshapes 52 Key 臉部捕捉表情; files and advice for 3D streaming
- Turnaround 製作時間: about 3–4 days per character with the AI process (AI-assisted modeling, hand-finished by the team); about 1 month fully hand-made AI 製程約 3–4 天，全人工製作約 1 個月
- To start 委託方式: send one front view (a three-view sheet is welcome) to get a free 3D preview, quote and schedule 寄一張正視圖即可取得免費 3D 預覽與報價
- Selected VTuber 3D projects 參與案例: 洛可洛斯特、璐洛洛、Aoi、貓祭；ReLive｜灰妲（幼妲）、諾櫻（幼櫻）、梅迪歐、十六月、魯波；預見娛樂｜神無月鹿比、穆克蕗、涅爾菲、鯨諾、魁、希洛萊昂；子午計畫｜汐 Seki、祈 Iruni、玥 Itsuki、実 Hitomi、雪 Koyuki、煦 Hiyori

## Products

- [3D Avatar](https://hiiiodigital.com/products/3d-avatar/): custom 3D character production 客製 3D 角色製作
- [Yugo BlenderTool](https://hiiiodigital.com/products/yugo/): free, open-source Blender add-on for VTubing 免費開源 Blender VTuber 外掛
- [VMCFacial](https://hiiiodigital.com/products/vmcfacial/): iPhone ARKit face tracking for VMC avatars iPhone 臉部追蹤
- [Yugodo Live](https://hiiiodigital.com/products/yugodo-live/): coming soon 即將推出
